title: Tab complete, in the right order
summary: Finishing a tab now always shows its tab-complete card last, after the advancement that finished it. With Advancement Plaques installed, the biggest advancements get a starry gold plaque of their own.
highlights: Tab-complete cards always arrive after the advancement that completed the tab
With Advancement Plaques, star-framed advancements show a starry plaque with a gold halo, sparkles and a chime
